title: Skill trigger eval cases (.claude/skills/<name>/evals.json)

prompt.description: Representative user phrase (RU or EN) that should activate the expected skill

expect.description: Skill name that must be selected. Usually the owning skill; cross-skill negative cases permitted (e.g., a phrase that must NOT route here points at the correct other skill).

$comment: Run semantics (research R5): each case = 3 model votes against the full skill-description catalog; pass >=2/3; 2/3 logs a flake warning. CI gate set = skills changed in the PR ∪ top-10 backfill list. Runner: scripts/skill-evals.mjs, model: Haiku-class, key via ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret (never in code/logs — Standing Order #4).
